_comment: VERSIONED TEMPLATE ledger (Faz-1a, no Postgres — ADR-0013). On first run conductor-tick.sh copies this to ~/.conductor-platform-builder/state.json and mutates THAT runtime copy; this template stays clean in git. status one of: todo | ready | running | done | blocked. A task is pickable when status in (ready, todo) and every dep id is done. scenario_ref is relative to tools/builder/scenarios/. retry_count caps at 2 -> blocked (ADR-0004). The PRE-STEP (Go contracts freeze) is task 0 and gates everything (ADR-0019).

tasks._note: ÖN-ADIM (ADR-0014 §7 / ADR-0019): freeze shared Go contracts. Single-performer + HUMAN sign-off before anything depends on it. Operator should review the diff and confirm before flipping dependents to ready.
Faz-1a Dalga A first task: in-memory StateStore impl behind the frozen interface.
Dalga A: registry business logic (ready-task selection + lease acquire/release + task lifecycle) on top of the frozen StateStore.
Dalga A: CommandEngine (EngineAdapter impl) + performer contract + deterministic LLM-resilience parse (ADR-0014).
Dalga B: per-project clone + per-task git worktree (fresh base) + gh-token auth + cleanup (ADR-0017).
Dalga B: deterministic gate runner (build/test/vet/lint -> Check[]) + repo-external holdout injection into verify-worktree -> ReviewResult; independent, Rule#9 (ADR-0003/0018).
Dalga B: deterministic liveness/reconcile (NO LLM) — stale-lease reaper + git-derived [task:<id>] reconcile, idempotent (ADR-0016).
Dalga C: tick-loop integration pick->workspace->develop->verify->merge->update (one fresh-context tick); wires the deps chain (ADR-0001).
Dalga C: conductorctl CLI — onboard/intake/status/pause/resume; minimal but working over the same StateStore (ADR-0011/0010).
